notes.title: New Diebrary Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Diebrary Patch 1.1.1: Auto Aim and Fire!

Features

In this patch we've added two new gameplay settings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/15916d20d641fd09e4a0468a3744a60c35c71801.gif

    Auto Aim
    When enabled, automatically point your primary weapon in the direction of the nearest enemy

    Auto Shoot
    Your Fire-button becomes a toggle for automatically firing your primary weapon
    Quickly toggle off shooting to reach a pet in need of rescue, then toggle it back on to resume the carnage!


Bugfixes


    Fixed a bug where damage would be increased +12% each level with no drawback

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/ad3f998016800fb8d23be4813166a033506d18a0.png

Diebrary Update 1.1.0: SHMUP Fest!

Gameplay

We've heard your feedback! Many players have said that the base game speed is too slow, so we have increased the overall pace of gameplay. While the 15 minute timer remains the same, the game itself is a bit faster paced - with characters and enemies all moving faster, shooting faster, and generally being more action-packed.

Pets


    Added Charlotte, a cute potted plant that will periodically grant you powerful buffs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/63d1665087baea4db4617ff8281b200c79b10916.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/ae0d893e586ec0a748037b8fecc2d63719cdf1d8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/7bc5a201d88f310785327fdb4394269ace907d0f.png

    Added Painterly, an adorable sea turtle that will send out a tsunami, pushes foes back

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/957257c2b17800859fa661d584576aa0ce30c7b8.gif


Plot Twists


    We've added [Hard] and [Brutal] warnings on some of the most dangerous Plot Twists
    Butterfingers: Reworked! Now deals much more damage to enemies, and tosses XP more consistently in all directions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790204/26afdc3aaa1f9e08ea141d7f74d116ad19b7bbca.gif

    A Shocking Number of Explosions: Reworked! Now several smaller explosions can appear back-to-back, instead of a single large one. This can be used to your advantage, chain-explode enemies!
    Paranormal Exercise: Ghost duration reduced from 10 -> 7s
    Spring-Time Dancing: We lowered the difficulty/insanity of this act 1 twist


Bug Fixes


    Fixed several crash bugs
    Fixed an issue with knockback sending enemies extremely far away

Attention Diebrarians!

 Diebrary Patch 1.0.1 is here!

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a freeze bug with Radar that happened after the final boss spawned
 Fixed a freeze bug with Fountains of Mana after the final boss spawned
 Fixed several other less frequent freeze bugs
 Fixed a bug with several achievements:

  - Going to a Rave Show
  - Nun of Your Business
  - The Baddest Juju

 Fixed a bug where Spear's hitbox would get messed up after several runs
 Fixed a bug with Barb's aura heart drop bonus

notes.title: RELEASE DATE CHANGE
notes.notes:

Dear Diebrarians,

Due to an unforeseen issue with the final builds, we will need to move the launch date to August 1st.

We're so excited to share what we have been working on, but unfortunately, there are a few last touches we need to make to ensure that you have the best experience possible with our game! :heart:

We hope that you understand, and look forward to seeing you all on August 1st!

In the meantime, please feel free to check our newly announced title:
